name: Veranda High Resort, MGallery Chiang Mai
insider_take: This elevated sanctuary sits majestically in the hills surrounding Chiang Mai, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the ancient Lanna kingdom below while maintaining the intimate charm of northern Thailand's cultural heart.
whats_special: As part of Accor's prestigious MGallery collection, this resort perfectly blends contemporary luxury with authentic Lanna heritage. The property's elevated location provides stunning sunset views over Chiang Mai's temple-dotted landscape, while the design incorporates traditional northern Thai architectural elements like teakwood accents and intricate Lanna motifs.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing west for unobstructed views of Doi Suthep mountain and its golden temple - the sunset views are absolutely spectacular and perfect for those Instagram-worthy moments.
dont_miss: The nearby Doi Suthep-Pui National Park houses the sacred Wat Phra That Doi Suthep temple, just a scenic 30-minute drive away. The resort's hilltop location also provides easy access to traditional hill tribe villages and some of northern Thailand's most authentic cultural experiences, while still being close enough to explore Chiang Mai's famous Night Bazaar and ancient temples.
pros: Stunning mountain views and elevated location
Distinctive MGallery boutique design and character
Peaceful retreat setting away from city crowds
cons: Remote location requires transportation to city center
Higher elevation may not suit all travelers
